tickets.title: Request estate document package
tickets.text: Obtain the current estate document package from Nolan Wrenpuddle, including any restatements, trustee acceptance language, durable power of attorney, health care directive, or attorney summary letter, to resolve discrepancies in his revocable trust and beneficiary records.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the current estate document package by 2026-02-19.

tickets.title: Resolve IRA beneficiary inconsistency
tickets.text: Resolve the inconsistency where the traditional IRA lists Lena and Oscar equally as beneficiaries while the Roth IRA still lists the 2014 revocable trust as the sole beneficiary, ensuring both accounts align with Nolan Wrenpuddle's expectation of direct passage to his children.
tickets.evidence: Further follow-up is needed by 2026-02-26 on the IRA beneficiary inconsistency, because Nolan expected both retirement accounts to pass directly to his children unless there was a specific reason to keep the trust on one account.
